Class ModelLessonDetail

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetail.ModelLessonDetail
public class ModelLessonDetail extends Object

Title: ModelLessonDetail Class.

Description: The Lesson Detail Page Model. It holds the lesson being examined, read fresh from the database, and performs the update and delete requests for it. Holding the lesson here means its ID, owner, and lock state are always the stored values, never values a widget could have changed.

  • Method Details

    • loadLesson

      protected static entityClasses.LessonsLearned loadLesson(database.Database database, int lessonId)

      Method: LessonsLearned loadLesson(Database database, int lessonId)

      Description: Reads the lesson from the database by its ID and makes it the current lesson. Reading it again, rather than using the object the My Lessons list held, means the page shows the latest stored values and lock state.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      lessonId - is the ID of the lesson to examine
      Returns:
      the lesson, or null if it no longer exists

    • saveChanges

      protected static database.Database.LessonResult saveChanges(database.Database database, String actingUser, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText)

      Method: LessonResult saveChanges(Database database, String actingUser, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText)

      Description: Saves the edited values to the current lesson (Contributor story 1, "I can see and manage it"). The ID and owner come from the stored lesson, so an edit can never move a lesson to another owner. The Database validates the values and checks ownership before changing anything.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      actingUser - is the logged-in contributor's username
      title - is the edited title
      category - is the selected category
      situation - is the edited situation
      lessonText - is the edited lesson text
      Returns:
      SUCCESS or the reason the update was refused

    • deleteLesson

      protected static database.Database.LessonResult deleteLesson(database.Database database, String actingUser, boolean confirmed)

      Method: LessonResult deleteLesson(Database database, String actingUser, boolean confirmed)

      Description: Deletes the current lesson if the contributor answered "Yes" to "Are you sure?". A "No" answer returns CANCELLED and changes nothing.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      actingUser - is the logged-in contributor's username
      confirmed - is true only when the contributor answered "Yes"
      Returns:
      SUCCESS, CANCELLED, or the reason the delete was refused
